value.rationale: The comparison fixes the embedded degree, a natural geometric complexity measure, and asks how singular-hyperplane discriminant degree varies across all Segre--Veronese polarizations of that size. The result gives two exact, sharp defect factorizations with complete equality cases and an arithmetic description of the discrete maximizer. This is more than a recomputation of isolated dual degrees: it supplies a global stability profile and exact extremal classification for the family.
